profile.headline: MLE
profile.summary: An experienced software engineer in machine learning (platform and applied machine learning).

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Software Engineer
positions.description: Tech Lead within the Ads Core ML organization, driving machine learning stack innovations from conception to high-impact production launches

positions.title: ML Platform
positions.description:
* PySpark effort at Pinterest. Medium Post: https://medium.com/pinterest-engineering/empowering-pinterest-data-scientists-and-machine-learning-engineers-with-pyspark-f41b0d1dd1b8
* Model Deployment
* Feature Monitoring for training pipelines
* Experiment Platforms

positions.title: Software Engineer, Data
positions.description: Working on the experimental framework & experimental data analytics. My team builds and maintains data pipelines that extract insights from all the A/B experiments at Pinterest.

positions.title: PhD Student in Computer Science
positions.description:
My research focuses on improving user experience with recommender systems. 
To that end, I have developed interfaces, implemented algorithms, run user experiments on a real recommender system, and statistically analyzed log data and experimental data. For my research, I have given talks and presentations, published papers, collaborated with colleagues, and mentored junior PhD students in my research domain. Please see my publications for more details.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Place-Insights of Google Maps. The objective of my internship was to improve predictions such as cocktails availability for businesses around the world.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: We investigated how wearable technologies could help people connect with each other easily. Thus, I developed a Google Glass application, a website embedded with LinkedIn, a Surface application, a ranking recommendation algorithm, and back-end data infrastructures (MySQL). I also enhanced Kinect body-tracking and webcam facial recognition codes, ran user experiments, and analyzed data. I have a full published paper for this work (CHI 2015)

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Led a team in developing an interactive web information system, and a team in behavioral studies from five universities

Analyzed students’ behavior and cognitive patterns using SPSS.

positions.title: Software / Web Engineer  Intern
positions.description:
Discussed with clients to understand user needs and business requirements

Built a credit-card web payment system compliant with the security and audit policy of University of Washington

Liaised with third parties for audit, security and testing features.

company.name: Center for Commercialization, University of Washington

positions.title: Application Analysis
positions.description: Acted as an IT consultant to help clients implement the information systems compliant with their business requirements.

certifications.name: Improving Deep Neural Networks: Hyperparameter tuning, Regularization and Optimization
certifications.title: Improving Deep Neural Networks: Hyperparameter tuning, Regularization and Optimization
